messages:
Elaine (Docs): Quick sync: I'm updating the 'heatmap/usage export' section for rate/quota docs. Need to confirm semantics for burst credits and tier attribution when a customer changes tiers mid-window.

Elaine (Docs): Draft SDK snippet below; thinking of adding curl and v2 examples too.

Elaine (Docs): ```python
# v1 sdk example
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=\"$REDWOOD_KEY\")
csv = client.usage.export_heatmap(start=\"2026-01-01\", end=\"2026-01-31\", group_by=\"allocation_tier\", include_burst=True, prorate=False)
print(csv)
```

Sahil (Eng-Platform): FYI backend supports include_burst flag (default False). Tier attribution defaults to allocation at window start; therexists an opt-in prorate behavior (prorate=true) that distributes tokens time-weighted across tiers.

Tina (Analytics): Confirming Sahil. Also: we report timezone in UTC. For prorate we do time-weighted by seconds in-window per tier. We round prorated tokens up to the nearest whole token for reporting CSVs.

Michael (Billing): Important distinction: reporting view != billing view. For invoices we bill against the committed tier per invoice rules (post-invoice adjustments handled separately). Recommend a short callout in the docs to avoid confusion.

Julia (DevEx): I'll add SDK examples for v2 and a curl example. Suggestion: show two short CSV rows in docs: one with allocation_at_start and one with prorate applied. Makes the difference tangible.

Elaine (Docs): Proposed copy: \"Heatmap exports are reporting artifacts. Set include_burst=true to include burst credit consumption in the 'used' column. By default tier attribution is based on allocation at the start of the reporting window; to enable time-weighted attribution set prorate=true. Billing follows committed tiers and may differ from the report.\" Thoughts?

Sahil (Eng-Platform): LGTM. Tiny nit: use group_by=\"allocation_tier\" in examples to avoid ambiguity.

Tina (Analytics): Add sample CSV line for prorate in the docs: \`2026-01-10,allocation_tier=pro,prorate=0.75,tokens=75000\` (meaning 75% of the window on pro).

Michael (Billing): :+1: Also add a short example showing invoice vs report for the same window to highlight differences.

Elaine (Docs): I'll incorporate all that. Julia, once you update the snippets can you open the PR?

Julia (DevEx): Done: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3346 ontains v1/v2 SDK snippets, curl example, csv samples, and a unit test. Requesting reviews: @Sahil @Tina @Michael

Sahil (Eng-Platform): Reviewing now. One request: add a note about behavior when include_burst and prorate are both true (we prorate burst consumption along with committed usage).

Tina (Analytics): Confirmed: we prorate burst tokens when both flags enabled, using the same time-weighting logic.

Elaine (Docs): Added final paragraph and UTC note. Will merge after approvals. Thanks! :rocket:
